About this item

  • Leakproof Lid You Can Trust: Designed with a secure sealing structure to help prevent leaks during daily carry, commuting, and backpack use.
  • Keeps Drinks Cold Throughout the Day: Double-wall insulated stainless steel helps keep beverages cold throughout workdays, commutes, and everyday activities.
  • Fits Most Cup Holders & Easy to Carry: Bottle size is designed to fit most car cup holders and features a carry-friendly design for daily use.
  • Built for Repeated, Long-Term Use: Reinforced lid structure and durable materials help withstand frequent opening, closing, and regular daily handling.
  • A Practical Choice for Daily Hydration: If you’re looking for a water bottle that works the way you expect—without leaks, surprises, or extra hassle—ENCOOL is made for you.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

5 out of 5 stars
The perfect water bottle
I'm in love. This water bottle is everything I could ask for. Its easy to clean, cute, and very easy to use. Nothing is so tight or stiff that it wont function properly or anything. I have the 24oz one so it's light even with ice in it and fits in my car cup holder without any issue. I'm able to even plop it into my purse without it taking up much room. In my experience so far, I've had no issues with leaking either. It keeps ice cold for almost the entire day. It has a slip proof silicone bottom that keeps it sturdy but doesn't catch fluff or animal hair on it. My boyfriend also has the same water bottle, but in a different color, and he's dropped it a million times. His still works properly, isn't dented, and is still leak proof.

    Title: Great Water Bottle for Sports and Camp

    Landon has been using this water bottle for baseball practices and games, swim practice, and summer camp, and it has worked great. It’s a good size for kids, easy to carry, and holds enough water to get him through his activities without needing constant refills.

    The insulation works well and keeps drinks cold, even when it’s hot outside. We haven’t had any issues with leaks, and it has held up well to daily use. The blue color looks nice, and the price was very reasonable for the quality.

    Overall, we’re very happy with this purchase and would definitely buy it again.

    18 Oz Perfect For Kids

    I bought two for my kids (9 1/2-years-old and almost 4-years-old) the Peach Purple and Frost Blue. They come looking exactly as described. I love that not only are they leak proof, but the texture of the bottle has a slightly bumpy feel to add friction so you are less likely to drop it. I also love that the spout is not a straw. It is molded at the top to act like a water bottle but has a piece that acts as a barrier to guide the water into your mouth rather than just pouring out. Will make drinking out of it immediately gratifying without being messy which is exactly what we need to survive our Disney vacation this August. Water stayed cold overnight with just a few ice cubes in each. The 18 Oz is perfect for kids or adults who need a more compact water bottle.

  • Dee
    4 out of 5 stars
    Top needs to go back more!
    Reviewed in the United States on January 22, 2026
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    My friends were trying to convince we to buy an owala, but the color I wanted wasn’t available in the 20 oz, so I decided to give this a try. I am so glad I did, because I actually like this one better! Looking at them both, they are very similar in design, but one main difference is that to drink from the o straw, you sip from the same opening where you free sip. This one has a straw piece that flips up behind the free sip area, which I like better. The cap seems sturdier, and the when the handle is down you can still press the button to open the cap to free sip. On the o, the handle prevents you from pressing the button, so you need to lift the handle to open the top to drink from it—I guess whether this is a pro or con depends on whether you want the button to be blocked or not. The button on this one is also easier to press to pop the top up. It does not leak at all, it fits in my car cup holder, and it kept my water cold for the 6 hours it took me to drink it. Even though I balked at spending $20 on a water bottle, it’s still cheaper than the other one by a fair amount, and I love the color—I will definitely be buying more in the other sizes!

    Edit: There are a few things I’ve noticed since I bought and have been using both the Encool and my Owala of the same size (35oz). The carrying handle is wider on the Encool, which I like better, and the bottom is rubberized, which is not the case on my o bottle. BUT one thing that this company needs to fix is that the top does not flip back far enough, so you are forced to tilt the bottle pretty far up when free sipping because it sticks into your forehead. I’m changing my review to 4 stars because this is pretty annoying, especially when I use the bottle to drink water, which I prefer to free sip.

    Dear Encool: Fix this problem and offer replacement tops to people who have already bought your bottles. They are perfect in every way EXCEPT for this incredibly annoying feature!

I’m changing my review to 4 stars because this is pretty annoying, especially when I use the bottle to drink water, which I prefer to free sip.

    Dear Encool: Fix this problem and offer replacement tops to people who have already bought your bottles. They are perfect in every way EXCEPT for this incredibly annoying feature!

Product Summary: ENCOOL Leakproof Insulated Water Bottle with Straw Dual-Sip Water Bottle Bag-Safe Design for Work, Commute & Gym – Keeps Drinks Cold All Day, 24 oz, Coffee White

About this Item

  • Leakproof Lid You Can Trust: Designed with a secure sealing structure to help prevent leaks during daily carry, commuting, and backpack use.
  • Keeps Drinks Cold Throughout the Day: Double-wall insulated stainless steel helps keep beverages cold throughout workdays, commutes, and everyday activities.
  • Fits Most Cup Holders & Easy to Carry: Bottle size is designed to fit most car cup holders and features a carry-friendly design for daily use.
  • Built for Repeated, Long-Term Use: Reinforced lid structure and durable materials help withstand frequent opening, closing, and regular daily handling.
  • A Practical Choice for Daily Hydration: If you’re looking for a water bottle that works the way you expect—without leaks, surprises, or extra hassle—ENCOOL is made for you.

Product Description

Most bottles let you drink one way. Some let you drink two ways — but leak in your bag. ENCOOL is designed for how you actually move through the day. Sip or pour, carry it anywhere, and don’t think twice. Stay hydrated your way with the ENCOOL Insulated Water Bottle, designed for everyday use at work, travel, and the gym. Crafted from 18/8 stainless steel and BPA-free materials, this bottle keeps your drinks fresh with no lingering odors or taste. The double-wall vacuum insulation helps maintain cold temperatures for extended periods, making it a reliable choice for daily hydration. The bottle features a convenient one-press lid that allows quick access when you need a drink. Whether you prefer slow sipping or a faster pour, it’s designed to fit different drinking styles for active days on the go. A leak-resistant design helps reduce spills during regular use, while the ergonomic carry handle makes it easy to take along wherever your day leads — commuting, workouts, or outdoor activities. Available in multiple sizes and colors, ENCOOL is made to match your routine and your style. Choose the size that best fits your needs and enjoy a reusable water bottle built for everyday life. INSTRUCTIONS FOR USE Wash before using. Lid is top-rack dishwasher safe. Handwashing the cup is recommended to preserve its finish. Do not use harsh chemicals (such as bleach, abrasives,etc.). Use astraw brush to clean the straw and fluid passage through thelid. Avoid accidental opening of the bottle by keeping the button free and clear of other objects. WARNINGS Do not microwave, freeze, or boil. For hygiene, avoid storing liquids that spoil easily, such as dairy or prepared infant formula. Also, do not use with carbonated drinks or beverages at high temperatures, as internal pressure may cause leakage.
